shortDescription: This module gathers various information from the IBM Spectrum Virtualize family storage systems

options.name: clustername
options.description: The hostname or management IP of the Spectrum Virtualize storage system.

options.name: domain
options.description: Domain for the Spectrum Virtualize storage system. Valid when hostname is used for the parameter I(clustername).

options.name: gather_subset
options.description: List of string variables to specify the Spectrum Virtualize entities for which information is required. all - list of all Spectrum Virtualize entities supported by the module. vol - lists information for VDisks. pool - lists information for mdiskgrps. node - lists information for nodes. iog - lists information for I/O groups. host - lists information for hosts. hostvdiskmap - lists all VDisks mapped to host 'objectname' vdiskhostmap - lists all hosts VDisk 'objectname' is mapped to hc - lists in

options.name: objectname
options.description: If specified, only the instance with the I(objectname) is returned. If not specified, all the instances are returned.

options.name: password
options.description: REST API password for the Spectrum Virtualize storage system. The parameters I(username) and I(password) are required if not using I(token) to authenticate a user.

options.name: token
options.description: The authentication token to verify a user on the Spectrum Virtualize storage system. To generate a token, use the ibm_svc_auth module.

options.name: username
options.description: REST API username for the Spectrum Virtualize storage system. The parameters I(username) and I(password) are required if not using I(token) to authenticate a user.
